Includes a graphical settings page."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-autofill-model-metadata"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Fills in a DSH gateway route's model metadata — `name`, `contextWindow`,
`maxTokens`, `input`, `reas"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"oningEfforts` — from the
models.dev catalog, using **only the mappings you declare
by hand**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH has no native metadata filling, and the plugins that add it guess: they
refresh a whole provider"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" from a catalog, or match model names loosely. This one
does neither. You write down which models.de"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"v record each of your model ids is,
and anything ambiguous is refused rather than filled."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A port of the Pi extension `pi-autofill-model-metadata`, moved onto the DSH
settings seam."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why explicit mapping"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **You say what each model is.** One line per route and local model id:
`mapping.<route>.<localMode"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"lId> = "<provider>/<model>"`.
- **No guessing.** No fuzzy matching, no case folding across providers"},{"id":"p8s3","text":", no trying
another provider when a lookup fails.
- **All or nothing.** A route that does not resolv"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"e completely is not written at
all, so you never get a half-filled model list.
- **Your fields win.*"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"* The plugin only fills fields you left empty."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Needs DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` and `pnpm` on `PATH`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`--profile` is the profile you actually boot (`web` for the browser UI,
`headless` for one-shot runs"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"). Pin the version: pnpm ≥ 11 will not resolve a
release published within its `minimumReleaseAge` wi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ndow. Then restart the profile
so the bundle mounts."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The plugin stays inert — no catalog fetch, no settings write — until you declare
a mapping. CONFIGUR"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ATION.md covers where that goes."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For LLM — agent install instructions"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If you are an agent whose task is to install this plugin, take the **npm path**
above — do not clone"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" the repository, build it, or install from a git spec. Follow
these steps:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. Find the profile to install into: `ls "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles"`,
and prefer the one the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" user actually boots (`web` for the browser UI).
`desktop` belongs to DSH Desktop and needs that app"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"'s own `dsh` binary.
2. Install a pinned version:
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-autofill-m"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"odel-metadata@<version>`.
Exit code 0 only means pnpm resolved the package; confirm the dependency w"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ith
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> list --depth 0` and the composed row with
`dsh --profile <profil"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"e> --dump-config`. If pnpm answers
`ERR_PNPM_NO_MATURE_MATCHING_VERSION`, the version is younger tha"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"n its
`minimumReleaseAge` window — pick an older published version
(`npm view dsh-autofill-model-met"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"adata versions`) rather than disabling the
setting.
3. Restart the profile so the new bundle mounts."},{"id":"p16s9","text":" Do not hot-patch around this.
4. Leave the configuration to the operator. An empty `mapping` is the"},{"id":"p16s10","text":" correct
post-install state — **never invent mappings**; every mapping must name a
models.dev record"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" the operator has chosen. Configuration steps, file
locations and the catalog search endpoint are in"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"
CONFIGURATION.md; report anything you are unsure of
instead of guessing."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"If pnpm refuses the package with an `allowBuilds` message, that only happens for
git-sourced install"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"s, which this package does not need: the published tarball
already ships `lib/`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Looking for the Pi or OpenCode implementation?"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"This plugin is a port, and the same idea exists on other harnesses:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **pi-extensions** —
`pi-autofill-model-metadata`, the Pi extension this plugin was ported from.
- "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"**opencode-plugins** —
`opencode-auto-model-config`, the OpenCode plugin that inspired both."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Documentation"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| document | covers |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| CONFIGURATION.md | where the config lives, the mapping, every field, the settings page, what gets "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"filled, refusals, troubleshooting, limitations |
| CONTRIBUTING.md | building, tests, the two bundle"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" halves, CI, releasing |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."}],"truncated":false}
